Listed below is all of the accessories in the game, listed in the same order
the game has them listed. Everyone can equip these accessories unless otherwise
noted, and each character can only equip one of the Headgear / Belt types at a
time. They can also only equip one of each item at a time, so having three
Mind's Eyes / Weird Bottles / etc. equipped isn't possible.

|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Raises Defense Power.                                  |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Bandanna                                               |
|                      A bandanna made by the hands of 100 virgins, using     |
|                      mystical dye and silk thread. It raises Defense        |
|                      Power.                                                 |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|

|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Raises Defense Power.                                  |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Leather Cap                                            |
|                      A cap made from the hide of Kublai Khan's favorite     |
|                      horse, Shooting Star. The horse was said to have       |
|                      become a dragon after its death. Raises Defense        |
|                      Power.                                                 |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Studded Cap        |    - /   -  |    6 /   -  |    - /   -  |  Headgear   |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Raises Defense Power.                                  |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Studded Cap                                            |
|                      A cap made of thin metal studded with rivets. The      |
|                      rivets are placed in accordance with the principles    |
|                      of feng shui. Raises Defense Power.                    |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Face Guard         |    - /   -  |    8 /   -  |    - /   -  |  Headgear   |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Raises Defense Power.                                  |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Face Guard                                             |
|                      A face guard made from human bones covered with        |
|                      lizard leather. You need courage to wear it, but it    |
|                      raises Defense Power. Extremely distracting to the     |
|                      enemy.                                                 |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Headgear           |    - /   -  |    9 /   2  |    - /   -  |  Headgear   |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Raises Defense Power by making target fearless.        |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Headgear                                               |
|                      Protective headgear worn by the cavalry division out   |
|                      routing evil. Strong defense against blows and other   |
|                      physical attacks. Raises Defense Power.                |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Circlet            |    - /   -  |    8 /   3  |    - /   -  |  Headgear   |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Raises Defense Power with magical protection.          |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Circlet                                                |
|                      A circlet made from silver gotten from the eastern     |
|                      capital's mystical mines and put through a magical     |
|                      process. Extremely lightweight. It raises Defense      |
|                      Power.                                                 |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Comet Mask         |    - /   -  |   10 /   6  |    5 /   -  |  Headgear   |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Mysterious mask exhumed by a certain foundation.       |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Comet Mask                                             |
|                      A golden mask excavated from the Aztec temple of the   |
|                      sun, said to have been worn by priests during sun-     |
|                      worshipping ceremonies. It raises Defense Power.       |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Seven-Eyed Mask    |    - /   -  |    9 /  10  |    5 /   -  |  Headgear   |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A mystical mask of the Aztecs.                         |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Seven-Eyed Mask                                        |
|                      Just like the Comet Mask, a mask excavated in Aztecan  |
|                      lands. However, this one was sealed up deep in the     |
|                      basements of the temple. It raises Defense Power.      |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Leather Belt       |    2 /   -  |    - /   -  |    - /   -  |  Belt       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Raises Attack Power.                                   |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Leather Belt                                           |
|                      A belt made from the hide of a young lion and tanned   |
|                      with the mystical Sensai stone. It raises Attack       |
|                      Power when worn.                                       |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Causal Belt        |    4 /   -  |    - /   -  |    - /   -  |  Belt       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Raises Attack Power.                                   |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Casual Belt                                            |
|                      A thin leather belt dyed in the secret potion of a     |
|                      holy man. It does raise the Attack Power of the        |
|                      wearer, but isn't very useful as a belt.               |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Western Belt       |    6 /   -  |    - /   -  |    - /   -  |  Belt       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Raises Attack Power.                                   |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Western Belt                                           |
|                      The favorite belt of frontier hero Billy, it raises    |
|                      Attack Power. The red stones set into the buckle are   |
|                      said to have a strong mystical power.                  |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Metal Belt         |    8 /   -  |    - /   -  |    - /   -  |  Belt       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Raises Attack Power.                                   |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Metal Belt                                             |
|                      A heavy metal belt. Raises Attack Power extensively,   |
|                      but you get a lot of odd looks when you wear it.       |
|                      Being a heavy metal fan helps.                         |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Charming Pareo     |    8 /   3  |    - /   -  |    - /   -  |  Belt       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Raises Attack Power by giving irresistible charm.      |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Charming Pareo                                         |
|                      A pareo like the one in the picture of the             |
|                      Micronesian goddess Akurol. Raises Attack Power but    |
|                      makes the wearer so irresistible, it attracts a lot    |
|                      of attention.                                          |
|                                                                             |
|                      NOTE: Can only be worn by women.                       |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Loin Guard         |    9 /   2  |    - /   -  |    - /   -  |  Belt       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Raises Attack by increasing masculine spirit.          |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Loin Guard                                             |
|                      The Loin Guard raises Attack Power by binding the      |
|                      wearer tightly. A symbol of the hot-blooded spirit of  |
|                      men throughout the ages.                               |
|                                                                             |
|                      NOTE: Can only be worn by men.                         |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Belt of Power      |   10 /   6  |    - /   -  |    - /   -  |  Belt       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): A belt once worn by a great jujutsu artist.            |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Belt of Power                                          |
|                      Belt worn by jujutsu artist Koma, who died in a        |
|                      foreign land after many fierce contests. Soaked with   |
|                      the blood of many strong opponents, it raises Attack   |
|                      Power.                                                 |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Belt of Thor       |   19 /  10  |    - /   -  |    - /   -  |  Belt       |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): The legendary belt once owned by the god Thor.         |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Belt of Thor                                           |
|                      The belt said to have been worn by the god of thunder  |
|                      Thor. In contrast to its beautiful appearance, it      |
|                      makes the wearer combative and raises Attack Power.    |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Shell Bracelet     |    - /   -  |    - /   1  |    - /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Renders Poison ineffectual.                            |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Shell Bracelet                                         |
|                      A bracelet carved out of a large, red, pearl oyster    |
|                      shell that was used by a medicine man in the Dark      |
|                      Ages. Raises resistance to Poison when worn.           |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Bone Bracelet      |    - /   -  |    - /   1  |    - /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Renders Confusion ineffectual.                         |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Bone Bracelet                                          |
|                      A bracelet carved out of the backbone of a priest who  |
|                      attained Buddhahood. Each piece has the text of a      |
|                      sutra. It renders the effects of Confusion             |
|                      ineffectual.                                           |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  RosewoodBracelet   |    - /   -  |    - /   1  |    - /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Renders Paralysis ineffectual.                         |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Rosewood Bracelet                                      |
|                      A bracelet made from rosewood from the holy land of    |
|                      Behem. Prayed over by many monks, it renders           |
|                      Paralysis ineffectual. A mandala is drawn on the       |
|                      back.                                                  |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Bell Bracelet      |    - /   -  |    - /   1  |    - /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Renders Silence ineffectual.                           |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Bell Bracelet                                          |
|                      A strung bell, made by placing the ear bones of a      |
|                      baby that died from illness into a bronze ball.        |
|                      Sounds like a baby laughing. Renders Silence           |
|                      ineffectual.                                           |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Mirror Bracelet    |    - /   -  |    - /   1  |    - /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Renders Petrification ineffectual.                     |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Mirror Bracelet                                        |
|                      A bracelet with a magic mirror made from polished      |
|                      silver dust produced through alchemy. The mirror       |
|                      repels evil and renders Petrification ineffectual.     |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Zodiac Bracelet    |    - /   -  |    - /   2  |    - /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Renders Paralysis and Petrification ineffectual.       |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Zodiac Bracelet                                        |
|                      A magic tool made by the Hungarian warlock Esca. It    |
|                      shows both the usual and the magic 12 signs of the     |
|                      zodiac. Renders Paralysis and Petrification            |
|                      ineffectual.                                           |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Cosmic Bracelet    |    - /   -  |    - /   2  |    - /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Renders Poison, Silence, Confusion ineffectual.        |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Cosmic Bracelet                                        |
|                      A bracelet representing the twelve animals of the      |
|                      Chinese zodiac, used in Yin and Yang fortune-telling.  |
|                      Renders Poison, Silence and Confusion ineffectual.     |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Spikes             |    - /   -  |    - /   1  |    - /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Renders Knock Back ineffectual.                        |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Spikes                                                 |
|                      The spikes of the base-stealing king, Quick-shoe       |
|                      Joey. Made from water buffalo leathers and set with    |
|                      silver spikes, they render Knock Back ineffectual.     |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Pocket Watch       |    - /   -  |    - /   1  |    - /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Renders Judgment Ring abnormalities ineffectual.       |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Pocket Watch                                           |
|                      The favorite pocket watch of the British warlock       |
|                      McNabb, who performed many magic experiments           |
|                      concerning time. It cancels out all effects on the     |
|                      Judgment Ring.                                         |
|                                                                             |
|                      NOTE: This also remedies some Lottery Ring anomalies.  |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Will Power         |    - /   -  |    - /   1  |    - /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Renders SP Lowering ineffectual.                       |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Will Power                                             |
|                      The pendant of Saint Eleph, it renders SP Lowering     |
|                      ineffectual. It has grown stronger as it has passed    |
|                      through the hands of many adventurers.                 |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Leonardo's Bear    |    - /   -  |    - /   1  |    - /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Renders Instant Death ineffectual.                     |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Leonardo's Bear                                        |
|                      A small teddy bear left behind in a cabin of the       |
|                      ghost ship St. Mary. It renders Instant Death          |
|                      ineffectual. Makes a sad face if you squeeze it.       |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Crucifix           |    - /   -  |    - /   5  |    - /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Renders Status abnormalities ineffectual.              |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Crucifix                                               |
|                      A replica of the crucifix on the chest of the giant    |
|                      god statue excavated from the ruins of Zafral.         |
|                      Renders all Status abnormalities ineffectual.          |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Moonstone Ring     |   -3 /   3  |   -3 /   -  |    5 /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Moonstone cuts Light damage in half.                   |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Moonstone Ring                                         |
|                      A ring made by a shaman with a moonstone dug up in an  |
|                      unexplored desert area. Used as a protective charm     |
|                      for the tribe. Cuts damage from Light attacks in       |
|                      half.                                                  |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Obsidian Ring      |   -3 /   3  |   -3 /   -  |    5 /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Obsidian cuts Darkness damage in half.                 |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Obsidian Ring                                          |
|                      The only accessory the tragic queen Escabete was       |
|                      wearing when she went to the guillotine. The obsidian  |
|                      is said to cry every night. Cuts Darkness damage in    |
|                      half.                                                  |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Amber Ring         |   -3 /   3  |   -3 /   -  |    5 /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Amber cuts Earth damage in half.                       |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Amber Ring                                             |
|                      A ring entirely made of amber, carved from a large     |
|                      amber stone found in an ancient layer of the western   |
|                      canyon. Cuts damage from Earth attacks in half.        |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Pearl Ring         |   -3 /   3  |   -3 /   -  |    5 /   -  |  Other      |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Pearl cuts Water damage in half.                       |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Pearl Ring                                             |
|                      A ring with a fresh-water pearl on a base of blue      |
|                      coral, worn by the witch Esla. The rainbow-colored     |
|                      pearl is still growing larger. Cuts Water damage in    |
